title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks slip amid doubts over US-Iran peace deal
title_zh: 富时 100 实时指数：因美伊和平协议存疑，股市下跌
summary: White House insists peace talks with Iran are ongoing, while Tehran has publicly rejected US overtures
summary_zh: 白宫坚称与伊朗的和平谈判正在进行中，而德黑兰则公开拒绝了美国的提议

title: Fiserv Reshapes Fintech Role With Western Alliance Deal And JP Morgan Hires
title_zh: Fiserv 通过西方联盟交易和摩根大通招聘重塑金融科技角色
summary: Fiserv (NasdaqGS:FISV) has entered its largest ever agent bank partnership with Western Alliance Bank, expanding its merchant technology reach in the Western US.
summary_zh: Fiserv（纳斯达克GS：FISV）已与西部联盟银行建立有史以来最大的代理银行合作伙伴关系，扩大其在美国西部的商业技术覆盖范围。

title: Dow Jones Futures: Stock Market Fades Amid Iran War Deal Hopes, Doubts
title_zh: 道琼斯期货：在伊朗战争协议的希望与怀疑中股市下跌
summary: The stock market slashed gains amid Iran war hopes and doubts. Space play Karman Holdings reported earnings late.
summary_zh: 在伊朗战争的希望和疑虑中，股市大幅下跌。太空游戏卡曼控股公司 (Karman Holdings) 晚间公布了财报。

title: Morgan Stanley Bitcoin ETF ready for ‘imminent’ launch. Here’s why that’s a big deal
title_zh: 摩根士丹利比特币 ETF 已准备好“即将”推出。这就是为什么这很重要
summary: This is the first Bitcoin fund from a major US bank. Morgan Stanley has 16,000 financial advisors managing around $6.2 trillion. Bitcoin ETFs already hold upwards of $83 billion in assets.
summary_zh: 这是美国主要银行的第一支比特币基金。摩根士丹利拥有 16,000 名财务顾问，管理着约 6.2 万亿美元。比特币 ETF 已持有超过 830 亿美元的资产。

title: Amazon Is Entering the Humanoid Robot Market. 3 Important Things to Know About the Fauna Robotics Acquisition.
title_zh: 亚马逊正在进军人形机器人市场。关于 Fauna Robotics 收购需要了解的 3 件重要事项。
summary: Amazon is gearing up to become a much bigger player in robotics.
summary_zh: 亚马逊正准备成为机器人领域更大的参与者。
